item.title: ▫️ Winners' successors in battle The T-80BVM tank crews of the 71st Motorised Rifle Division of the Sever Group of Forces
item.description: Winners' successors in battle ▫️ The T-80BVM tank crews of the 71st Motorised Rifle Division of the Sever Group of Forces continue to burn down the enemy's positions in Kharkov region. 💥 Every shot is precisely aimed at the target. The tank commander with the call sign 'Grom' told what does it mean to wear the proud Guards title on the front line: ‘Every day, we try to confirm the title of the Guards by our combat work, moving forward, pushing the Nazis away. We are fighting to keep our civilian population's sleep tight, not to shame the honour of our heroic ancestors, who beat Nazism 80 years ago in the same way. And we are fighting in memory of those who posthumously received the title of Heroes of Russia, those who gave their lives to defend our borders, to destroy these neo-fascists’. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:

🎖
🎖
by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation
as of 13 September 2026
Part 2 (
👉
see Part 1
)
📍
The Tsentr Group's units improved the tactical situation.
Russian elements inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of four mechanised brigades, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, three marine brigades, the Azov Special Forces Brigade, and four national guard brigades close to Vodolazhskoye, Maryevka, Ivanovka, Novotroitskoye (Dnepropetrovsk region), Belozerskoye, Andreyevka, Novoandreyevka, Dobropolye, Verovka, Yuryevka, and Zavidovo-Kudashevo (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU's losses amounted to more than 420 troops, one armoured personnel carrier, one armoured fighting vehicle, 12 motor vehicles, and one artillery gun.
🔥
The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depth of the enemy's defence.
Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, two air assault brigade, three assault regiments, one unmanned systems regiment of the AFU, and one marine brigade close to Orestopol, Krivorozhskoye, Kolomiytsy, Pavlovka (Dnepropetrovsk region), Obshcheye, Golubkovo, Voskresenka, Svetlaya Dolina, and Slavnoye (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 285 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, nine motor vehicles, and one field artillery gun.
↗️
The Dnepr Group of Forces' units took more advantageous lines and positions.
Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one mountain assault brigade, and one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine near Orekhov, Balabino, Zaporozhets, Yulyevka, Zapasnoye, Yurkovka, and Preobrazhenka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
Up to 45 troops, 26 motor vehicles, two electronic warfare stations, and one radar station were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-tactical aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation inflicted damage on
the logistics centres, fuel, power, and transport infrastructure facilities of Ukraine used by the AFU, assembly workshops and storage areas for unmanned aerial vehicles, ground robotic systems, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed forces and foreign mercenaries in 146 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
seven guided aerial bombs, two HIMARS-made MLRS projectiles, and 902 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.
📊
In total,
since the beginning of the special military operation, the enemy
has lost:
▫️
674
aircraft,
▫️
284
helicopters,
▫️
234,975
unmanned aerial vehicles,
▫️
672
anti-aircraft missile systems,
▫️
30,912
tanks and other armoured fighting vehicles,
▫️
1,777
MLRS combat vehicles,
▫️
36,444
field artillery guns and mortars,
▫️
71,789
special military vehicles.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🚩 The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
item.description: The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation. 🚩 Units of the Sever Group of Forces continue to tighten the encirclement around the enemy's formations and expand the external control zone in Kharkov region. As a result of active actions, the control over the settlement of Chernyakov (Kharkov region) was established by the Russian troops. 💥 Strikes were delivered at the encircled AFU's manpower and hardware near Malaya Volchya, Budarki, and Buzovo (Kharkov region). 🔥 The enemy's manpower and hardware were hit on the outer perimeter of the encirclement close to Novoaleksandrovka and Prikolotnoye (Kharkov region), as well as the destruction of the AFU's units continue to be carried out in the area of Olkhovatka (Kharkov region). The enemy's attempts to break through the encirclement near Sliznevo and Gogino (Kharkov region) were thwarted. ▪️ Over the past 24 hours, the enemy has lost up to 55 militants and one ground robotic system. 🔥 In addition, in Kharkov region, strikes were delivered at formations of three mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and two territorial defence brigades near Shevchenkovo, Staritsa, Novoselovka, Pogoreloye, Khatneye, and Fedorovka. 📍 In Sumy region, manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and one territorial defence brigade were neutralised close to Doroshovka, Velikaya Chernetchina, Boyaro-Lezhachi, Sennoye, Esman, and Krovnoy
item.content:encoded:

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
🚩
Units of the Sever Group of Forces continue to tighten the encirclement around the enemy's formations
and expand the external control zone in Kharkov region. As a result of active actions,
the control over the settlement of Chernyakov
(Kharkov region)
was established by the Russian troops.
💥
Strikes were delivered at
the encircled AFU's manpower and hardware near Malaya Volchya, Budarki, and Buzovo (Kharkov region).
🔥
The enemy's manpower and hardware were hit
on the outer perimeter of the encirclement
close to Novoaleksandrovka and Prikolotnoye (Kharkov region), as well as the destruction of the AFU's units continue to be carried out in the area of Olkhovatka (Kharkov region).
The enemy's attempts to break through the encirclement
near Sliznevo and Gogino (Kharkov region)
were thwarted.
▪️
Over the past 24 hours, the enemy has lost up to 55 militants and one ground robotic system.
🔥
In addition,
in Kharkov region, strikes were delivered at
formations of three mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and two territorial defence brigades near Shevchenkovo, Staritsa, Novoselovka, Pogoreloye, Khatneye, and Fedorovka.
📍
In Sumy region,
manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and one territorial defence brigade
were neutralised
close to Doroshovka, Velikaya Chernetchina, Boyaro-Lezhachi, Sennoye, Esman, and Krovnoye.
▪️
In total, up to 230 troops, seven armoured fighting vehicles, 18 motor vehicles, and one 155-mm Bogdana howitzer were neutralised in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group of Forces.
↗️
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
Formations of tree mechanised brigades, one airmobile brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one presidential brigade, and one territorial defence brigade near Karpovka, Rubtsy, Beloye, Starodubovka (Donetsk People's Republic), Sobolevka, Solenoye, and Peski Radkovskiye (Kharkov region).
▪️
The enemy losses amounted to up to 220 troops, one Kazak armoured fighting vehicle, 15 motor vehicles, one U.K.-made Braveheart self-propelled artillery system, and one Polish-made Krab self-propelled artillery system, as well as one electronic reconnaissance station.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Russian elements inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of four mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, two airmobile brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, and one territorial defence brigade near the settlements of Yasnogorka, Kramatorsk, Slavyansk, Druzhkovka, Rayskoye, Vasilevskaya Pustosh, Novoselovka, Nikolayevka, and Orekhovatka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 205 troops, two Kazak armoured fighting vehicles, and 17 motor vehicles. Two field artillery guns, including one 155-mm U.S.-made Paladin self-propelled artillery system, were neutralised.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ During the night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out group strikes against logistics centres
item.description: ❗️ During the night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out group strikes against logistics centres through which military supplies are delivered and distributed, as well as energy facilities that support their operation. 💥 Air-based high-precision weapons and attack drones hit : ▪️ the Novaya Pochta logistics centre used to store and distribute military equipment intended for the support of the Armed Forces of Ukraine in the settlement of Nerubayskoye (Odessa region). ▪️ the Usatovo power substation in the city of Odessa and the Novaya power substation in the city of Nikolayev, which operate port and logistics infrastructure in Odessa and Nikolayev regions. ▪️ In addition, railway infrastructure facilities in western regions of Ukraine providing transport of military cargo from European countries were hit. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🏭 To have health as strong as tank armour, and iron will! Andrei Belousov congratulated servicemen, veterans and employees of defence enterprises on the Tankman day
item.description: To have health as strong as tank armour, and iron will! Andrei Belousov congratulated servicemen, veterans and employees of defence enterprises on the Tankman day ‘Tankmen have written many heroic pages into our military history, always demonstrating unparalleled courage, steadfastness and mutual support. These qualities, along with professionalism and a sense of responsibility for Russia's fate, enable them to operate successfully during the special military operation," noted the Defence Minister. 🏭 Andrei Belousov stressed that scientists, designers, engineers and workers of tank-building plants, who create formidable combat vehicles, help tank crews reliably carry out combat missions. Thanks to them, tanks remain an effective weapon on the battlefield today and are not being retired. ▫️ The Defence Minister wished today's tank crews to multiply the glorious traditions of their predecessors, hone their military skills, and stand guard over Russia's sovereignty. 🤝 Thank you for your courage, and for your faithful and heroic service! 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
